notes.title: Let’s welcome the Full Release of Lucid Dream!
notes.content:
Today, Lucid Dream officially ended the EA phase and is available in the full release version. Now you can discover the whole story of little Lucy, meet new amazing characters and cross unknown worlds of dreams. The fate of little Lucy is in your hands now!

This is a special moment for the whole Dali Games team. At this point, we want to thank the entire community gathered around Lucid Dream. Thanks to your advice and suggestions, the game has experienced a real wind of change. We have implemented a number of key improvements and modifications, so that the pleasure of discovering the story of little Lucy will be even better, and the satisfaction of solved puzzles will be even greater. Your participation in the creation of Lucid Dream is invaluable!

The magical world of Lucid Dream is waiting for you!

notes.title: Full Release on 8th of October
notes.content:
Hi,

Lucid Dream is scheduled to transition from EA to Full Release on 8th of October 2018.

To improve the game we have made number of critical changes, therefore if you will proceed with today's update, all game progress will be reset - apologies, there was no way to avoid this.

We have as well redesigned all dialogues (today's update), therefore for very short time game will be English and Polish only. We are awaiting for Russian, German and French  translations to be finished and will add them in short time (probably within the week from now. Therefore all languages will be added before Full Release).

Best regards,

Dali Games team

notes.title: Big update
notes.content:
Hi, 

this time we have a large update. We are especially pleased with the new version of Lucy. We hope you will like it. You will find full list of changes below.

Big changes:

-new version of Lucy
-chapter 2 update: check gameplay fixes and ride new moon elevator
-chapter 3 update: check new gameplay and meet the hairy, mysterious -creature living in the planet
-listen to the updated music in Chapter 5

What else?

-improvement of dreamcatcher animation in the room
-changing interaction areas at selected locations
-eepairing bugs reported by the community

Kindest regards
Dali Games

notes.title: Lucid Dream - finalist of the Pixel Awards 2018!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Lucid Dream has become one of the finalists of the Pixel Awards 2018, the 6th edition of the largest competition in Poland for independent video game developers. This year, the jury selected finalists from a record number of 129 games, the more we are happy that we have found ourselves in such a great company!

See you on 8-10.06 in the old bus depot in Warsaw.

Keep your fingers crossed for us!

You can find more about Pixel Heaven here:

https://www.pixelheavenfest.com/en/
https://www.facebook.com/events/128093031167249/

notes.title: Another update available!
notes.content:
We provide you with another Lucid Dream update. We hope that you will like the changes. Let us know what you think about them?


1. We have modified level 2 gameplay – after some signals from the community, we decided to change gameplay, we are constantly working on improving the mechanics of puzzles, so we would be grateful for your opinion about the changes. Due to the update, progress in the level 2 will be automatically reset.
2. We have improved the music to level 1 and 2
3. We have made improvements to Level 5
4. How to play - a tutorial available in inventory
5. Small fixes to level 1, enlivening the surroundings (curtains, spider)
6. Some changes to Portals lvl (tunnel)


Kindest regards,
Dali Games

notes.title: Meet Dali Games - part 2
notes.content:
A crumb of news about Dali Games

Dali Games was founded to create a unique adventure game. All our attention is currently focused on the completion of Lucid Dream, but we already have dozens of ideas for new productions in our heads, which we want to release in the future thanks to your support.

The Lucid Dream budget is entirely self-financed and the production work carried out after hours. Each of us professionally deals with other projects,  so the more we are proud of the effect that we have achieved. We do not rest on our laurels and we are constantly working with you on the final touch of Lucid Dream.

We want our games to raise important social problems, have a soul, delight visually and have an interesting gameplay. We hope that this simple recipe will allow us to achieve success, which will help us to develop the studio and work full-time on new projects.

notes.title: Update, which will show you the way!
notes.content:
We are offering you another Lucid Dream update! We decided to implement additional functionalities listening to your opinions. We are extremely grateful for the support and valuable advice you give. Your opinion is crucial for us, which is why we think that we are very lucky that a wonderful and active community is being created around Lucid Dream! Thanks a lot!
Below, full list of new functionalities:

•	highlighting the key items for the story (hold spacebar on Sleepwalker difficulty level)
•	descriptions of items in the inventory (click right mouse button on item)
•	book of hints
•	choosing the level of difficulty
•	increasing area of cursor, signaling possible interactions (on Sleepwalker and Dreamer difficulty level)
•	bugs fixes (reported by the community)
•	new entries in the diary


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32158431/2a266f426e0801608559a32b4fbedf9813ca5872.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet Dali Games
notes.content:
We would like to get to know you better, find out why you decided to buy Lucid Dream and what you expect from the final version. We believe that the best way will be first to introduce ourselves and tell you a little bit more about our studio and the work on Lucid Dream. We would like to introduce you to a short information cycle “meet Dali Games”.

Who we are?

Four people are the core of Dali Games:

Greg - the brain of the whole operation, fearless conqueror of all problems and master of the organization. It moves nimbly around the code mazes. The term "can not" does not exist in his dictionary.

Jake - an artist, a real mine of ideas, a Renaissance man with broad interests. His graphic works are dazzling, even long after entering the world of dream. Every day opens our eyes to new solutions.

Piter - although he deals with numbers on a daily basis, at Lucid Dream he worked on the word. The stories he invented gives us the creeps, and the unheard puzzles often remain a mystery, even for other members of Dali Games.

Lukas - multi-instrumentalist, with angelic patience bearing the opinions of the rest of the team, the author of the most depressive track ever, for which the rest of the team bows to him.

notes.title: Such a great community is like winning lottery ticket!
notes.content: We are extremely impressed by your activity for the Steam community centered around Lucid Dream. The passion with which you help those who have wandered for a moment on the winding paths of Lucid Dream delights us and is a huge motivation. We decided that by the end of the Early Access phase we will award the most active users of the Steam Hub with a special gift. We wondered what it could be like. We have a few ideas, but we also count on your creativity. Write in the comments how we can repay you for your support and help :) Once again thank You in behalf of the whole Dali Games :)

notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the bug that prevented the purchase of Lucid Dream on the Steam service has been already repaired, thus we are officially starting the Early Access phase! 

You must know that minor problems with sales kick-off are nothing compared to the problems facing Lucy, the main character of Lucid Dream. Do not hesitate and help little Lucy battle the demons tormenting her loved-ones. 

With a special 40% discount on Steam only until Friday.
